organizations_analytics.insightSummary:
**Funding Performance Summary**

There simply isn't enough data here to draw meaningful conclusions about this organization's fundraising performance. With only two recorded grant outcomes and no funder category breakdown available, any pattern we might describe would be more storytelling than analysis. What we can say is that when awards have come through, they've averaged $45,000 — a solid grant size — but the dollar efficiency of 56 cents awarded for every dollar requested suggests there may be room to better align ask amounts with what funders are prepared to give, or that some applications have come back unfunded. As more outcomes are tracked over time, the platform will be able to surface genuinely useful insights about which funder types are the best fit and where to focus energy. Keep logging your grant activity — the picture will get clearer quickly.
